The '''Gam Tim'nisi system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tungra sector/Legends|Tungra sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the [[Gam Tim'nisi asteroid belt]].
